'
Til You Do Me Right
" is a song by American
R&B
group
After 7
. The song is the opening track on the group's third studio album,
Reflections
, and was issued as the album's first single in June 1995. It was their final hit on the US
Billboard
Hot 100
, peaking at number 31 in 1995, and it also reached the top 20 in Australia and New Zealand; in the former nation, the song is
certified
gold for shipping over 35,000 copies.
